# OKF conformance examples

The small `acme.md`, `crypto.md`, `ga4.md` and `stackoverflow.md` fixtures are adapted, reduced examples of the corresponding bundles in [GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/tree/8cf3abaf1ee3d53a12f981cc0ed83d6ffec775e1/okf/bundles), reviewed at commit `8cf3abaf1ee3d53a12f981cc0ed83d6ffec775e1`.

They exercise format shapes and are not verified analytical definitions. The upstream repository is distributed under the Apache License 2.0; its license is retained in `LICENSE.txt`. `preservation.md` is a Thread regression fixture for YAML fidelity.

Thread's format implementation is independent JavaScript code; no upstream reference agent, cloud deployment tool or executor is embedded.
